name: shot_sheet
description: Sample N frames per detected shot and tile them into contact sheets, with a tile index mapping every tile back to its shot. Pure ffmpeg. Feeds the B-roll footage index — multiple frames per shot make action and camera motion legible where a single frame cannot.

output.description: {input, frames_per_shot, sheets:[{path, cols, rows, tiles:[{shot_index, frame_index, t, row, col}]}]}

params.name: shots
params.description: Path to this video's detect_shots JSON

params.name: out-dir
params.description: Directory to write sheet images into

params.name: frames-per-shot
params.description: Frames sampled per shot. 3 is enough to read action; 1 gives subject only.

params.name: max-tiles
params.description: Tiles per sheet before splitting into another sheet

params.name: out
params.description: Write the index JSON here instead of stdout
